source_access: Original paths are provenance only; read only frozen files explicitly listed in workspace.
preconditions: Side grasp, native Dex3 mesh, calibrated current stereo, actual opposite finger/fruit enclosure visible before closing; stationary support verified.
principle: After failed higher/forward enclosure, reopen, withdraw with clearance, lower and re-enter while open. Confirm opposing enclosure, close with fresh evidence, test retained lift and raise full object clear of rim before short transport. Release only over visible opening.
exit_evidence: Consult the referenced public final stereo pair and phase-specific public skill; host certification is separate from what each image proves.
range_scope: whole successful episode, not a claim that every action is an effective atomic skill

control_contract.timing: 50Hz tracker/200Hz MuJoCo; physics paused for reasoning

when_not_to_use: No fixed coordinates, object pose estimates or chunk replay. Side-grasp condition does not prescribe top-grasp palm height. No validated loaded gait or post-release withdrawal/hold.
unverified: No new cross-task outcome, loaded locomotion or true handover established by this index.
